performed: Captain Marvel and Billy Batson find themselves mysteriously projected into a topsy-turvy world where everything is backwards, upside-down, inside out and distorted— THE FANTASTICALLY UNBELIEVABLE REALM OF THE SUBCONSCIOUS!

[warm, confiding, to the audience] Folks, sometimes I've been asked what was the MOST AMAZING adventure Captain Marvel ever had. [thoughtful] Well— you know, Captain Marvel's been just about everywhere and done almost everything— but I think the most amazing thing that ever happened to him was— [suddenly catching himself] BUT WAIT! [conspiratorial] Here's how it all began.
[storytelling, quiet] I was walking home from the broadcasting studios rather late one night, when—
[distant, terrified shouting] HELP! HELP! SAVE ME!
[startled] WH-WHAT'S THAT?
[shouting up at someone] HEY! What are you doing down there?
HELP! HELP!
HELP! I'm falling!
SHAZAM!!
Lightning splits the air and—
—it's Captain Marvel to the rescue!
[desperate, breathless] HELP! Help! Help!
[heroic, confident shout] Coming!
[panicked yell] HELP!
[calm, reassuring] Take it easy!
[stern but friendly scolding] You ought to know better than to try a stunt like that!
[cheerful] Back we go!
[dizzy, whimpering] I'm falling! I'm dizzy! HALP!
[concerned] DIZZY!? [kindly] Brother, you're in no condition to be out on the streets. I'd better take you home!
[shaky, out of breath] H-here— here's where I live!
[encouraging] WELL, let's go up the stairs!
[rising panic] Stairs! STAIRS? That's what started the whole thing! STAIRS! I can't get up them!
[screaming] I'M FALLING!
[weak, fading] H-HELP!!
[sighs, matter-of-fact] He's passed out. Might as well carry him in and put him to bed.
[quietly satisfied] I've done about all I can. [lowered voice] And now— SHAZAM!
[groggy, alarmed] W-what was that? And WHO are you?
[gentle, soothing] It's all right, mister, just lie back and you'll be all right in the morning!
[frantic] NO! NO! Nothing will ever be right again! NOTHING! [moaning] OOOOOOH! [laughing hysterically] AH-HAH-HAH-HAH-HA!
[hysterical laughter] HAH! HAA! HAA! [raving] Stairs! Stairs! [cackling] Haaa!
[alarmed] HOLY MOLEY! The old fellow's throwing a fit!
[exhausted, calming down] I— I'm all right now!
[relieved exhale] WHEW! I'm glad THAT'S over.
[curious, a little awkward] Now suppose you tell me what this is all about— Mister— er—
[recovering his dignity, proud] Smith— PROFESSOR EDGEWOOD SMITH is my name, sonny.
[wry, self-aware] Sometimes people call me "EDGEWISE" Smith. [hesitant] They think— they think I'm QUEER— [chuckles] and they're right— mostly. [proudly] Look at this room of mine, for instance!
[amazed, woozy] WOW! It makes me dizzy just to look at it!
[delighted, showman] Precisely! But now I'll show you a trick!
[pleased] See? From this position it looks right!
[unconvinced, polite] We-ell, ALMOST right, anyhow!
[lecturing, enthusiastic] See? When you first look— the stairs go UP. Then when you look again— they seem to go DOWN!
[genuinely impressed] HMMM! So they do! Amazing!
[gleeful, like a magic trick] Now here are SIX cubes! But turn the drawing upside down and there are SEVEN!
[sly, leading question] Now of course you can comb your hair in front of an ordinary mirror, can't you? Even though your reflection is really left-handed?
[confident] Why, sure— anybody can!
[triumphant, pointed] But when a SECOND mirror shows you as you REALLY are, you're all confused, aren't you?

[intense, tapping his head] See? It's all in your subconscious mind— HERE! [rapid, building excitement] You can't even read ordinary writing held to a mirror because it's backwards! And yet you comb your hair backwards and can't do it frontwards when the extra mirror shows you how you really are!
[flustered, edging away] It's— it's all very confusing— I think I'd better go!
[nervous, polite] G-GOOD NIGHT, Professor.
[cheerful, a little ominous] Good night, sonny— watch those stairs!
[to himself, amused] WOW! What a crackpot that Professor "Edgewise" Smith is! [chuckling] And to think it's all in his SUBCONSCIOUS mind! [smug] I'm glad MY subconscious mind doesn't bother ME!
Little does Billy realize what is about to happen to him!
Some hours later—
[groggy, grumbling] HMMPH! I must have fallen out of bed! Well, it's time to get up anyway!
[yelps in pain] OW! [confused] What's that lighting fixture doing here in the middle of the floor?
[horrified realization] HOLY MOLEY! Maybe it's happened to me like it did to Professor Smith! I'M— I'M UPSIDE DOWN!
[panicked] YEEOW! I'd better get dressed and get out of here!
[dismayed] Omigosh! I can't even see my own face in the mirror any more!
[uneasy, muttering] Things certainly look queer! I don't blame old Professor Smith for getting dizzy!
[aghast] AND THE PEOPLE! I wonder if I look like THAT to THEM!
[puzzled] THAT'S FUNNY! This elevator's going DOWN!
[bored, sing-song announcing] SIXTY-FIFTH FLOOR! SIXTY-FIVE! Let 'em out!
[forced politeness, stammering] Why, good morning, Miss Dalshaw! How— er— NICE you look this morning!
[pleasant, businesslike] Good morning, Billy. Mr. Morris wants to see you right away.
[hearty, jovial boss] Good morning, Billy! All set for a good hard day's work at Amalgamated Broadcasting?
[under his breath, astonished] GOSH! What a costume! I must look funny in my plain old blue pants and red sweater!
[trying to sound normal] Good morning, Mr. Morris.
Back in Billy's office...
[gulps, embarrassed] ULP! I forgot I can't even see myself anymore!
[frustrated] GOSH! How am I gonna read these news reports? THEY'RE all mixed up, too!
[exasperated] IT'S NO USE! I can see it— but I still can't read it!
[urgent, excited] Come on, Billy— WE'RE OFF TO THE FRONT!
[confused] Wh— what front?
[impatient, rallying] Why, the WAR FRONT, of course! The invasion and all! TO THE ROOF!
[shocked] The INVASION? Here?
[shouting over engine noise] CLIMB IN, BILLY! HURRY!
[shouting, confused] But— but, Mr. Morris, if we're going to the FRONT, wouldn't it really be the BACK? [flustered] Er— I mean— oh, I'M ALL TWISTED UP!
[alarmed shout] LOOK OUT! We're being attacked!
Even in this weird, twisted, upside-down-and-backward world, Billy finds men whose only thought is to kill without mercy!
[screaming, panicked] We're out of control!! WE'RE FALLING!
[shouting with all his might] SHAZAM!
In answer to Billy's desperate shout, the familiar flash of yellow lightning splits the air with a deafening report... and...
...good old Captain Marvel takes over!
[commanding, confident] Come on, Mr. Morris! I can handle the situation— if Billy can't!!
[relieved] Here we are, safe— [stumbles] WUP! [laughs at himself] I'm STILL a little twisted! [confident] But after all, I'M more able to take this sort of thing than Billy Batson is!
[alert, looking around] Just where are we now, Mr. Morris?
[uncertain, stammering] Why— ah—
[menacing, barking, from off] Surrender or be killed, dogs!
[cold, threatening] Come quietly and you will not be harmed, but I warn you....
[defiant, booming] SAVE YOUR WARNINGS FOR SOMEONE WHO NEEDS 'EM!
[grunts, knocked down] OH!
[cheering] Bravo, Captain Marvel! We'll show 'em!
[yelps] OW!
[panicked yell] HELP!
[righteous, punching] Pull a gun on Captain Marvel, will you? NEXT TIME YOU'LL KNOW BETTER!
[turning, menacing] AND AS FOR YOU...
[urgent, pleading] Wait, Captain Marvel... DON'T...
[stunned disbelief] GREAT JUMPIN' JUPITER... A GIRL!
[grave] Yes, their leaders are all women!!
[firm, a bit cocky] Come on, sister! YOU'RE going to take us to your leader! I'll soon put a stop to this female invasion!
[haughty, commanding] FOLLOW ME!
[confident] You bet we'll follow you!
[gruff, suspicious] And don't try any tricks on US!
[startled, in the dark] Hey! It's black in here!
[angry, frustrated] Where'd that girl get to? SHE'S GIVEN US THE SLIP.
When the lights flash on again—
[dazed, stammering] Wha— who— how...?
[pointing, alarmed] That girl! SHE IS the leader of the invasion!
[imperious command, from off] SEIZE THEM!
[confused] Eh...? What the? [alarmed] HELP!
[desperate] Captain Marvel! Do something!!
[shouting] FIGHT!
[anguished, struggling] It's no use, Mr. Morris! I can't... fight... WOMEN!
[cruel, triumphant] THEN THROW HIM INTO THE PIT!! We shall see if he's any braver when he FACES, and FIGHTS, the monster FLESMIH!
[bewildered, frustrated] I don't know what's come over me! I don't usually let anyone toss me around like this!
[wry, regaining composure] Well, at least I'm getting used to this topsy-turvy world enough so that I can land right-side up again!
[crowd chanting] WE WANT FLESMIH!
[jeering] Turn loose the monster!
[bloodthirsty shouting] FIGHT! He'll fight FLESMIH!
[chanting] FLESMIH!
[eager, rubbing his hands] Ah! Maybe this FLESMIH fellow will be something I can really let myself go at! Wonder what he looks like?
[horrified disbelief] NO! NO! It— it CAN'T be! Why— this is... UTTERLY IMPOSSIBLE!
Even the indomitable Captain Marvel pales at the first sight of the horrible monster turned loose on him!
[taunting, fists up] Come on, you overgrown nightmare! I'M READY FOR YOU!
[lunging] Now I've got you...! [surprised] OOPS! [baffled] Where did he go?
[startled] OH! [annoyed] Now you're all swelled up! Think you're too smart for me, do you?
[furious] BLAST YOU! Why don't you keep one shape till I can catch you?
[eureka] Ah! THAT'S IT! [mock photographer] HOLD THAT POSE! Chin just a little higher— [winding up] HERE IT COMES—
The whole universe seems to explode in one mighty blast of energy as Captain Marvel finally connects with the jaw of Flesmih!
[waking with a start, panicked] H-Holy Moley! I've overslept! I've just got five minutes to dress and get to the office!
